$comment: MACHINE-READABLE STATUTORY REGISTER. Every calculation-critical rule in Kuwick payroll, with its authority, its implementation, its test and its verification status. NOTHING here may be upgraded to OFFICIAL_SOURCE_VERIFIED or OFFICIAL_TEST_VECTOR_VERIFIED except by a named person who has opened the official document. A competitor product agreeing with a value is NOT verification.

verificationStatuses.UNVERIFIED: No authoritative source has been consulted. May not drive live payroll.
verificationStatuses.CORROBORATED: Agrees with a non-authoritative source (clinic workbook, competitor product, calculator). Still may not drive live payroll.
verificationStatuses.OFFICIAL_SOURCE_VERIFIED: A named person has compared the implementation against the authority's published document, recorded here.
verificationStatuses.OFFICIAL_TEST_VECTOR_VERIFIED: The implementation passes the authority's own published test vectors.

accessPosition.result: ALL TIER A AUTHORITIES UNREACHABLE FROM THE BUILD ENVIRONMENT
accessPosition.detail: kwsp.gov.my, perkeso.gov.my, hasil.gov.my, phl.hasil.gov.my, hrdcorp.gov.my and jtksm.mohr.gov.my all fail at the network proxy. api.github.com returns 200 from the same proxy, so this is egress policy, not fault.
accessPosition.consequence: No rule below may leave UNVERIFIED until an authority is reachable or a person supplies the official document.
